# Portugal

Region: Europe. Sources verified 2026-10-11. Scope follows source documentation, not assumed nationwide CAMT availability.

## Country / regional references

### Banco de Portugal / Task-Force C2B

**Role:** Central-bank host of Portuguese national customer-bank XML manual

**Reporting coverage:** Reviewed public manual covers payment initiation, reversals and status, with no CAMT reporting. This does not prove Portugal lacks a separate reporting specification.

**Messages / versions:** pain.001.001.03; pain.008.001.02; pain.007.001.02; pain.002.001.03

- [C2B normalised SEPA XML manual 4.00, November 2019](https://www.bportugal.pt/sites/default/files/c2b_-_registo_normalizado_xml_v04_00.pdf) — payment-guideline; public-file

Public 155-page manual 04.00 dated 2019-11-18 verified. Message table p24 lists 001/002/007/008; appendix contains payment examples. No CAMT text found. Manual 4.00 is not a CAMT namespace. A newer manual was not verified; label this a dated reference.
